project.name: Homefield
project.description: A web app for friends to fill out NFL playoff brackets, pay entry fees, and compete for best score

userStories.title: Initialize Nuxt 4 project with NuxtUI and Supabase
userStories.description: Set up the foundational Nuxt 4.2 project with NuxtUI v4, Tailwind CSS v4, and Supabase client integration
acceptanceCriteria: Nuxt 4.2 project initializes without errors
NuxtUI v4 components render correctly
Tailwind CSS v4 utilities work in templates
@nuxtjs/supabase module is installed and configured
Environment variables for Supabase URL and anon key are in .env.example
Dev server runs on localhost:3000
stepsToVerify: Run `npm run dev` and confirm no errors
Create test page with NuxtUI Button component
Apply Tailwind class and confirm styling
Check Supabase client is accessible via useSupabaseClient()

userStories.title: Create Supabase database schema
userStories.description: Define all database tables, relationships, and RLS policies in Supabase
acceptanceCriteria: users table extends auth.users with first_name, last_name, created_at
pools table has id, name, invite_code, owner_id, entry_fee, locks_at, created_at
pool_members table has pool_id, user_id, joined_at
brackets table has id, user_id, pool_id, name, payment_status, payment_id, submitted_at, created_at
games table has id, season_year, round, home_team, away_team, winner, starts_at, espn_game_id, actual_total_points, actual_total_yards
picks table has id, bracket_id, game_id, picked_team, super_bowl_total_points, super_bowl_total_yards
Foreign key relationships are correctly defined
RLS policies restrict pick visibility until after locks_at
RLS policies allow users to only edit their own unpaid brackets
stepsToVerify: Run SQL migrations in Supabase dashboard
Insert test data for each table
Verify foreign key constraints reject invalid references
Test RLS policies with different user contexts

userStories.title: Implement magic link authentication flow
userStories.description: Users can sign in via email magic link using Supabase Auth
acceptanceCriteria: /login page has email input and submit button
Submitting email triggers Supabase signInWithOtp()
Success message displays after email submission
Magic link redirects to /auth/callback
/auth/callback exchanges token and creates session
Authenticated users are redirected to /bracket
Unauthenticated users accessing protected routes are redirected to /login
stepsToVerify: Enter email on /login page
Check email inbox for magic link
Click link and verify redirect to /bracket
Refresh page and confirm session persists
Log out and verify redirect to /login when accessing /bracket

userStories.title: Implement profile completion flow
userStories.description: New users must enter first and last name after first login
acceptanceCriteria: After first magic link login, user is redirected to /profile/setup if name is missing
/profile/setup page has first_name and last_name inputs (required)
Submitting updates the users table
After profile completion, user is redirected to /bracket
Returning users skip profile setup and go directly to /bracket
stepsToVerify: Sign in as new user
Verify redirect to /profile/setup
Submit names and verify redirect to /bracket
Log out and back in, verify direct access to /bracket

userStories.title: Implement pool join flow
userStories.description: Users can join a pool by entering an invite code
acceptanceCriteria: /join page has invite code input
Valid invite code adds user to pool_members table
Invalid invite code shows error message
Users already in pool are redirected to /bracket
After joining, user is redirected to /bracket
stepsToVerify: Navigate to /join as authenticated user
Enter invalid code, verify error displays
Enter valid code, verify pool_members row created
Verify redirect to /bracket
Revisit /join, verify redirect since already member

userStories.title: Display bracket list and create new bracket
userStories.description: Users see their brackets and can create new ones
acceptanceCriteria: /bracket page lists all user's brackets for current pool
Each bracket shows name, payment status, and created date
'Create New Bracket' button opens modal or navigates to creation form
Bracket name is optional with fallback to 'Bracket #N'
New bracket is saved to brackets table with payment_status='unpaid'
User can create unlimited brackets
stepsToVerify: Navigate to /bracket with no brackets, verify empty state
Click 'Create New Bracket', enter name
Verify bracket appears in list
Create bracket without name, verify auto-generated name

userStories.title: Build bracket editor UI
userStories.description: Users can fill out their bracket picks through a visual bracket interface
acceptanceCriteria: /bracket/[id] page displays full NFL playoff bracket structure
Wild Card round shows 6 games (3 AFC, 3 NFC)
Divisional round shows 4 slots connected to Wild Card winners + #1 seeds
Conference Championship shows 2 slots connected to Divisional winners
Super Bowl shows 1 slot connected to Conference winners
Clicking a team in a matchup selects them as winner
Selecting a winner cascades: team advances to next round slot
Changing a pick in earlier round clears downstream picks involving that team
Selected teams are visually highlighted
stepsToVerify: Load bracket editor with game data
Click team in Wild Card game, verify advancement to Divisional
Pick through to Super Bowl, verify all rounds update
Change Wild Card pick, verify downstream picks reset
Verify visual feedback for selected vs unselected teams

userStories.title: Add tiebreaker inputs to bracket
userStories.description: Users enter Super Bowl total points and total yards predictions
acceptanceCriteria: Bracket editor includes numeric input for 'Super Bowl Total Points'
Bracket editor includes numeric input for 'Super Bowl Total Yards'
Inputs are required for bracket submission
Values are validated as positive integers
Values are saved to picks table (super_bowl_total_points, super_bowl_total_yards)
stepsToVerify: Fill out complete bracket
Leave tiebreaker fields empty, verify submission blocked
Enter valid values, verify they save correctly
Reload page, verify values persist

userStories.title: Save bracket picks as draft
userStories.description: Bracket picks auto-save or save on user action while still unpaid
acceptanceCriteria: Picks are saved to picks table associated with bracket_id
Partial brackets (not all picks made) can be saved
Unpaid brackets remain editable
Returning to bracket editor loads existing picks
Delete bracket button removes unpaid bracket and associated picks
stepsToVerify: Make partial picks, navigate away
Return to bracket, verify picks loaded
Complete bracket, verify all picks saved
Delete unpaid bracket, verify removal from database

userStories.title: Integrate PayPal JS SDK
userStories.description: Set up PayPal JS SDK with PayPal and Venmo payment options
acceptanceCriteria: PayPal JS SDK loads on checkout component
PayPal Smart Buttons render (PayPal + Venmo options)
Environment variables for PayPal client ID configured
Sandbox mode works in development
Production mode configurable for deployment
stepsToVerify: Load checkout component
Verify PayPal button renders
Verify Venmo button renders (when eligible)
Click PayPal button, verify modal opens

userStories.title: Implement bracket checkout flow
userStories.description: Users pay for all unpaid brackets in a single transaction
acceptanceCriteria: Checkout displays list of unpaid brackets
Total calculates as (unpaid bracket count x entry_fee)
PayPal/Venmo button initiates payment for total amount
On payment success, client receives transaction ID
Server-side /api/payment/verify endpoint validates transaction with PayPal API
Valid payment updates all unpaid brackets: payment_status='paid', payment_id set, submitted_at set
User sees success message and brackets lock
stepsToVerify: Create 2 unpaid brackets
Go to checkout, verify total = 2 x entry_fee
Complete PayPal sandbox payment
Verify both brackets now show payment_status='paid'
Verify brackets are no longer editable

userStories.title: Handle payment edge cases
userStories.description: Gracefully handle payment failures and edge cases
acceptanceCriteria: User closing PayPal modal returns to checkout with brackets intact
Payment failure shows error message, brackets remain unpaid
Server rejects payment if amount doesn't match expected total
Attempting payment after locks_at shows 'picks locked' error
Concurrent payment attempts for same brackets handled safely
stepsToVerify: Start payment, close modal, verify brackets still unpaid
Force payment failure in sandbox, verify error message
Attempt to manipulate amount, verify server rejection
Set locks_at to past, attempt payment, verify rejection

userStories.title: Build leaderboard with scoring
userStories.description: Display ranked list of all paid brackets with scores
acceptanceCriteria: /leaderboard page shows all paid brackets in the pool
Each row shows: rank, display name (First L. - Bracket Name), score
Score calculates as: Wild Card correct x 1 + Divisional x 2 + Conference x 4 + Super Bowl x 8
Brackets sorted by score descending
Ties show same rank
Only paid brackets appear on leaderboard
stepsToVerify: Add game results for some games
Verify scores calculate correctly
Verify ranking order is correct
Add unpaid bracket, verify it doesn't appear

userStories.title: Implement tiebreaker display
userStories.description: Show tiebreaker differences on leaderboard when scores are tied
acceptanceCriteria: Leaderboard shows columns for TB1 Diff and TB2 Diff
TB1 Diff = abs(user's predicted total points - actual total points)
TB2 Diff = abs(user's predicted total yards - actual total yards)
Tied scores sort by TB1 Diff ascending, then TB2 Diff ascending
Tiebreaker columns only show values when Super Bowl is complete
stepsToVerify: Create two brackets with same score
Enter Super Bowl actual points and yards
Verify tiebreaker diffs display correctly
Verify tied entries sort by tiebreaker

userStories.title: View other users' brackets after lock

acceptanceCriteria: Before locks_at: users can only see their own brackets
After locks_at: users can view any paid bracket in the pool
Clicking bracket name on leaderboard opens bracket viewer
Bracket viewer shows all picks in read-only mode
Correct/incorrect picks are visually indicated (if results are in)
stepsToVerify: Before lock: verify other brackets not accessible
After lock: click bracket on leaderboard
Verify bracket displays read-only
Verify correct picks show green, incorrect show red, pending show neutral
